<!-- pr-reviewer: e2cbcd0fef2879e158904d8f98d6b40853e82382 -->
Needs changes before merge.

What looks good:
- The new helpers keep the same button actions, labels, radio order, and integer range.
- The spring-pass input now has an accessible name.
- The PR uses `Refs #1122` because it completes only one page family. No snapshot PNG or NC golden changes.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 703af8185f7cfc574050d0187502b4b42d6b67eb:
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 784 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored. Both new form-seam tests and all four thread-page tests passed.
- Integration tests: boundary 3 passed; boundary_picks 6 passed; sinker_setup 1 passed; theme_files 14 passed. No failures.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick gate dry run selected the UI library and those four integration suites. All tests ran from `crates/ui`.

Requested before merge:
1. PR body; UI change at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:36` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/thread_page.rs:112`: add before and after screenshots to the PR body. The required images are absent. Show the affected Drill, Bore, and Thread controls so the reader can compare their layout.

Notes:
- This PR changes UI controls only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. Safety-tier mutation runs do not apply. I did not run mutations or change the code.
- No code defect was found. The missing screenshots are the one blocking item.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the one review finding: the PR body now embeds before and after screenshots for Drill, Bore, and Thread. The images and capture provenance are in docs/reviews/1724. No product code changed.

Pin: python3 docs/reviews/1724/check_screenshots.py <saved-PR-body>. Removing the Drill before embed failed with “PR body lacks image drill-before.png”. Restoring it passed. The published PR body also passes.

New head: 486b03c91c8b1330f1e79ec47500ad68625fdd5a.
Quick gate passed against upstream/main. UI clippy passed with warnings denied.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 486b03c91c8b1330f1e79ec47500ad68625fdd5a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Review results:
- The helpers keep the same button actions, labels, radio order, and spring-pass range. The spring-pass input has an accessible name.
- The PR body now has before and after images for Drill, Bore, and Thread. I checked the images and the capture record. Each image pair has the same file hash. The earlier request for images is complete.
- The PR uses `Refs #1122` for this page family. It changes no release snapshot PNG or NC golden.

Local checks after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at a89d47128d33d3793e7871cc95f311892a672397:
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 786 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored. This includes the form-seam and thread-page tests.
- Integration tests: boundary 3 passed; boundary_picks 6 passed; sinker_setup 1 passed; theme_files 14 passed. No failures.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick gate dry run selected the UI library and these four integration suites. All tests ran from `crates/ui` in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested changes: none.

Notes:
- This PR changes UI widget calls only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. Safety mutation runs do not apply. I did not run mutations.
- I read the image check script but did not run it. I checked the six image links and PNG files directly.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed the latest review findings.

1. Merged upstream/main (fe1a94c7) with a clean merge commit. Updated the tools-and-machine limit to 204 and the multi-axis limit to its current merged baseline of 16. The holes guard stays at zero. Pin: pages_do_not_add_raw_egui_calls_outside_the_form_seam. Restoring 202 failed with 204 raw calls; restoring 204 passed. The old multi-axis limit also failed; 16 passed. Both form_seam tests pass.
2. Confirmed the repository keeps review evidence. Existing examples on main are docs/reviews/1756, docs/review/1765 and docs/pr-1711. Recorded this in docs/reviews/1724/README.md. All six images remain embedded in the PR description. Pin: check_screenshots.py with the saved published PR body. Removing the Drill-before embed failed; restoring it passed.

New head: 9df66d0ddfd553a8e929d5ada4b5eb61420fb260.

cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed: 823 tests passed, 5 ignored.
UI clippy with all targets and warnings denied failed on two unrelated items from main: unused PNG_256 and taskbar_icon in crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs. They were left unchanged to keep this fix within the review findings.

The PR was returned to draft before the plain push. No labels were changed. Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9df66d0ddfd553a8e929d5ada4b5eb61420fb260 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Review results:
- The helpers keep the same actions, labels, radio order, and spring-pass range. The spring-pass input now has an accessible name.
- The raw-call guard passes with main. The tools-and-machine limit is 204, the multi-axis limit is 16, and the holes limit stays at zero. This completes the first request from the previous review.
- The PR body has before and after images for Drill, Bore, and Thread. I inspected the images and their capture record. Each image pair has the same file hash. The README confirms that the repository keeps review evidence and gives existing examples. This completes the second request from the previous review.
- No new dependency, release snapshot PNG, or NC golden changes. The decision record is present. `Refs #1122` is correct for this part of the issue.

Local checks after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at ebda4f2f:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected the UI library and four integration suites.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 799 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored. Both form-seam tests and all four thread-page tests passed.
- Integration tests: boundary 3 passed; boundary_picks 6 passed; sinker_setup 1 passed; theme_files 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on two existing Linux warnings in main:

```
error: constant `PNG_256` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:12:7
error: function `taskbar_icon` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:40:8
```

The merged `app_icon.rs` is identical to upstream/main. These warnings are not changes from this PR. All tests ran from `crates/ui` in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested changes: none.

Notes:
- This PR changes UI widget calls. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. Safety mutation tests do not apply. I did not run mutations or edit the code.
- I read the image check script but did not run it. I checked the image files and the PR body directly. I did not run the GUI or release pixel tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the one finding in the latest review. Merged upstream/main cleanly. The raw-call guard now covers only the migrated holes and thread pages, with a hard limit of zero. Removed the unrelated family limits.

Pin: form_seam_guard_covers_only_the_migrated_holes_family. Restoring the old families fails this pin and reproduces multi-axis 18 > 16. Restoring the fix passes all three form-seam tests. Adding a raw label to holes_page.rs fails pages_do_not_add_raw_egui_calls_outside_the_form_seam; restoring the source passes.

New head: 97639a3f9183c41012aa9eb7d9f1632b5ad1352b.

cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed: 829 passed, 5 ignored. UI clippy with all targets and warnings denied fails on the existing PNG_256 and taskbar_icon dead-code warnings in app_icon.rs. That file is identical to upstream/main and was left unchanged.

The PR remains a draft. Please re-review.
